paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of "Attention Weights" across varying intervals of "Exp. Length." The horizontal categorical axis, labeled "Exp. Length," features numeric tick marks ordered ascendingly from 5 to 35 at intervals of 5, which demarcate six contiguous bins (5-10, 10-15, 15-20, 20-25, 25-30, and 30-35). The vertical value axis, labeled "Attention Weights," employs a linear scale with a displayed range starting from a baseline of 0.20 up to 0.45, featuring tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The chart contains six solid blue bars with black outlines that are positioned without gaps between them, sorted sequentially by their horizontal axis numerical intervals rather than by height. The first bar for the 5-10 interval reaches an approximate value of 0.38. The tallest bar is located in the 10-15 interval at approximately 0.41, followed closely by the 15-20 interval bar at nearly the same height. The values are roughly 0.36 for the 20-25 range and reach their lowest point at the shortest bar in the 25-30 range with a value of approximately 0.32, before ending at roughly 0.35 in the final 30-35 interval. No individual bars are uniquely emphasized, and all share the same blue fill and black border formatting.
